clue.text: Competitive flier, say, used to do business between races

definitions.text: used to do business between races

indicators.note: say signals that the word for the flier is to be spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: a racing bird flown in competitions is a pigeon

explanation.surface: A racing bird is apparently used for trade between rival racing events.
explanation.walkthrough: 'races' looks like more racing, but here it means peoples: a pidgin is a simplified trade language used between speakers of different tongues.
explanation.definitionFit: A pidgin is a simplified contact language that grew up so traders from different peoples could deal with one another.

clue.text: Youngsters play it — father scores

parts.note: pop is an informal word for father
scores are written music

explanation.surface: Children perform a piece while their dad scores the goals.
explanation.definitionFit: Chart songs aimed at teenagers are the style young people listen to and perform.

clue.text: Steering group for clubs

definitions.meaning: people who steer, those at the wheel of cars
golf clubs used for long shots from the tee

explanation.surface: A committee guiding a set of societies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clubs' looks like societies, but these are golf clubs: the driver is the long club for tee shots.
explanation.definitionFit: Those at the wheel of cars steer them, and the longest golf clubs, used off the tee, have that name.

clue.text: Revolting to see one partnership demanding attention

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
in bridge, North and South play together as a partnership, NS
something urgent demands immediate attention

explanation.surface: It is sickening to watch a couple who keep demanding notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolting' means rising in revolt, not disgusting; NS is the North-South pair at a bridge table.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebel who takes part in an uprising is in revolt against authority.

clue.text: Boarded survival craft when in fix

indicators.note: in says the craft goes inside the word for fix

parts.note: to fix something firmly in place is to embed it
Noah's ark was the vessel that survived the Flood

explanation.surface: Someone climbed into a lifeboat when in a tight spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fix' reads as a predicament, as in 'in a fix', but here it is a verb meaning to set firmly; 'in' signals the insertion.
explanation.definitionFit: To embark is to go on board a ship, so having embarked is having boarded.

clue.text: Road's main composition is creating problems

parts.note: the M1 motorway is written MI, so road's gives MI plus S
main means principal or chief
composition is the making or forming of something

explanation.surface: The structure of the main road is causing trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is Britain's first and best-known motorway, London to Leeds; crosswords write its 1 as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: Stirring up trouble or discord between people is causing difficulties on purpose.

clue.text: Anxious, neurotic Germans suffered this, initially

definitions.text: Anxious, neurotic Germans suffered this, initially

indicators.note: initially says the first letter of each of the preceding words is taken

explanation.surface: Nervous, troubled Germans endured this state of dread.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the definition and the wordplay: the German word for fear, borrowed into English.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is German for fear and in English names a deep, nagging anxiety.

clue.text: A piece of luck? No — who wins shows skill

indicators.note: piece of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Is winning down to luck? No: whoever wins displays ability.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'shows skill' is a verb phrase, but KNOW-HOW is a noun: the definition is 'skill' and 'shows' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Practical expertise, knowing how to do something, is ability or skill.

clue.text: Record-holding responsibility for legal assistant

indicators.note: holding says the word for responsibility contains the record

parts.note: a duty is a responsibility
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A clerk with the duty of keeping records helps a lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Record-holding' looks like one adjective, as for a champion, but it splits: the responsibility holds the record.
explanation.definitionFit: A deputy is someone legally empowered to act in place of a superior.

clue.text: Devil's continental representative, his chief ambassador to the French

definitions.note: the definition is the word Devil; the 's stands for is, linking it to the wordplay

parts.note: an MEP is a Member of the European Parliament
top means chief or foremost
an ambassador is addressed as His Excellency, HE
les is French for the (plural)

explanation.surface: Satan's envoy to Europe, his leading diplomat sent to France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'continental' signals Europe: an MEP represents a constituency in the European Parliament.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Faust legend the demon to whom Faust sells his soul is the Devil's agent and often stands for Satan himself.

clue.text: Hero, for example, one established in news media

indicators.note: in says one and established go inside the word for news media

parts.note: the press is the collective term for newspapers and journalists
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A heroic figure has become a fixture in the newspapers.
explanation.walkthrough: Hero is not a brave person but the figure of Greek legend, priestess of Aphrodite, lover of Leander.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek legend Hero served Aphrodite at Sestos as a temple priestess.

clue.text: Some musicians in band together

definitions.meaning: a set of players such as a pop band
to gather or combine into one body

explanation.surface: Some musicians in a band get together.
explanation.definitionFit: A pop or rock ensemble is called a group, and to group is to gather into a body.

clue.text: Discover a foreign land

parts.note: un is the French word for a
earth means land or soil

explanation.surface: An explorer finds an exotic country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a foreign' means 'a' in a foreign language: French UN.
explanation.definitionFit: To unearth something is to dig it out or bring it to light, so to find it.

clue.text: It's used to cut ends off thatch etc.

indicators.note: ends off says the outer letters of the phrase thatch etc. are dropped, leaving the run inside

explanation.surface: A tool for trimming the edges of a thatched roof.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the T at the start and the C at the end of THATCHETC.
explanation.definitionFit: A small axe is a chopping tool, used for cutting wood.

clue.text: Publication for children

definitions.meaning: one edition of a periodical
offspring, in the old legal sense of descendants

explanation.surface: A magazine aimed at youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: An edition of a magazine is an issue, and a person's offspring are their issue in legal language.

clue.text: Resign or leave 18, perhaps

definitions.meaning: to give up an office or position
to get off a raised platform, the answer to 18 across

explanation.surface: Quit your job, or simply get off the stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 18 across is PLATFORM: getting off a platform is one way of stepping down.
explanation.definitionFit: To quit a post is to stand down, and walking off a raised stage means taking a pace downwards.

clue.text: Less rapid changes in broadcasting

indicators.note: changes says the letters of less rapid are reshuffled into another order

explanation.surface: Slower developments in radio and television.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcasting' is not radio but sowing seed by scattering it widely.
explanation.definitionFit: Broadcasting originally meant scattering seed over a wide area, which is spreading things out.

clue.text: Title and what goes with it for top place on board

definitions.text: Title and what goes with it
definitions.meaning: a newspaper's name printed at the top of the front page with its date and details
the highest point of a ship's mast

explanation.surface: A heading and its accompanying details, the highest position on the board.
explanation.walkthrough: 'board' suggests a company board, but it is on board a ship: the top of a mast.
explanation.definitionFit: A newspaper's nameplate with its date and price line is its masthead, and the top of a ship's mast is the lookout's highest point.

clue.text: Area at Waterloo from where gun could be fired

definitions.meaning: a raised part of a railway station such as London's Waterloo where passengers board

definitions.text: from where gun could be fired
definitions.meaning: a raised base on which a gun is mounted

explanation.surface: A spot at the famous battlefield from which artillery opened fire.
explanation.walkthrough: Waterloo suggests the battle, which the gun reinforces, but it is the London railway station.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway station has raised areas for boarding trains, and a gun emplacement is a raised mounting.

clue.text: Deception gets cricket side a draw

parts.note: the leg side is one half of a cricket field
a pull is a draw, as on a rope or a pipe

explanation.surface: A trick allows a cricket team to escape with a tied result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'draw' tempts as a tied match; here it is a tug. The leg side of a cricket field is the half behind the batter's legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Pulling someone's leg is teasing them with a hoax, so a hoax is a trick.

clue.text: It's as if nothing changed in capital

indicators.note: changed says the letters of as if and the nothing are reworked into a new order

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Life in a capital city carries on as though nothing had happened.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges ASIFO (AS IF plus O) into the capital of Bulgaria.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bulgarian capital city is Sofia.

clue.text: Sweet and loving member of colony

parts.note: fond means loving or affectionate
ants live in colonies

explanation.surface: A gentle, affectionate person belongs to a settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet' looks like an adjective to go with 'loving', but it is a noun, a soft sugar confection.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, creamy sugar paste is a confectionery, used to fill chocolates and ice cakes.

clue.text: Close pipe down

definitions.meaning: to close or lock up, as a shop at night
to stop talking or be quiet

explanation.surface: Shut up shop and keep quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut up a building is to close it, and to stop talking is to be quiet.

clue.text: Possibly Napoleon's rations? Nonsense!

definitions.meaning: food for a pig such as Napoleon in Orwell's Animal Farm
an exclamation dismissing something as rubbish

explanation.surface: Did the French emperor eat this? Rubbish!
explanation.walkthrough: Napoleon is not the emperor but the pig who rules in Orwell's Animal Farm; pigswill is a pig's food.
explanation.definitionFit: Swill fed to pigs is literally their wash, and the word is also slang for rubbish talk.

clue.text: King following a short distance behind

indicators.note: following says the royal abbreviation comes next, placed behind the letters for a short distance

parts.note: ft is the abbreviation for foot, a short distance
ER is Edwardus Rex, the royal cipher of King Edward

explanation.surface: The monarch trails a little way back.
explanation.walkthrough: ER is usually the Queen; here it is Edward Rex, the cipher of King Edward VII and VIII.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming later in time or place, at the rear, is being in the rear.

clue.text: Maintain cricket practice and one will hold one's catches

parts.note: to maintain something is to keep it
cricketers practise in nets, so a net session is practice

explanation.surface: Keep up your net sessions and you will hold the catches that come your way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'catches' sounds like cricket, but the catches are fish: an angler keeps a day's fish alive in a long net in the water.
explanation.definitionFit: An angler stores the fish landed during a session in a long mesh bag left in the water.

clue.text: Guy initially talks to Sally, perhaps

indicators.note: initially says take just the first letter of talks

parts.note: Aunt Sally is a fairground figure that people throw things at, so Sally is an example of an aunt

explanation.surface: A man first chats to a woman named Sally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guy' is the verb, to mock. Aunt Sally is a British fairground game of throwing sticks at a wooden head, and so a byword for a target of abuse.
explanation.definitionFit: To guy someone is to ridicule or mock them, as a jeer does.

clue.text: Brown work, a sort of painting

definitions.meaning: the kind of work Capability Brown did, designing grounds of great estates
a genre of picture showing countryside

explanation.surface: A piece by an artist called Brown is a kind of picture.
explanation.walkthrough: Brown is Capability Brown, the 18th-century English gardener who designed country-house parks.
explanation.definitionFit: Capability Brown laid out parkland scenery, and a painting of rural scenery is a genre of art.

clue.text: Produce extreme rift between star and sweetheart

parts.note: Polaris is the Pole Star
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter E

explanation.surface: Something drives a wedge between a celebrity and the person they love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' reads as a celebrity but is the Pole Star; 'sweetheart' is the centre of 'sweet'.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide people into two sharply opposed camps is to push them to opposite extremes.

clue.text: Played instrument with groovy ornamentation

definitions.meaning: played a woodwind instrument held sideways
decorated with grooves, as on a column

explanation.surface: A musician played with groovy flourishes.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing a woodwind pipe can be described as this verb, and a column carved with grooves is said to be grooved this way.
